title: Add AGENTS.md with Cursor Cloud development instructions
body: Adds `AGENTS.md` with development environment instructions for Cursor Cloud agents. ## What's included - Service overview (single Vite dev server, no backend) - Key commands: install, dev, build, test, preview - Non-obvious notes: base path, test artifacts, available app modes ## Environment verification The development environment was fully verified: - `npm install` — all dependencies installed successfully - `node test-pipeline.mjs` — all 30 audio pipeline tests pass - `npm run build` — production build succeeds - `npm run dev` — Vite dev server starts and serves the app - Manual testing in Compose mode (entering swaras and playback) works end-to-end [ezswara_compose_and_playback_demo.mp4](https://cursor.com/agents/bc-2f598579-4489-4766-ba49-fd7d7b7eb6db/artifacts?path=%2Fopt%2Fcursor%2Fartifacts%2Fezswara_compose_and_playback_demo.mp4) [Compose mode with notation entered](https://cursor.com/agents/bc-2f598579-4489-4766-ba49-fd7d7b7eb6db/artifacts?path=%2Fopt%2Fcursor%2Fartifacts%2Fezswara_notation_entered.webp) To show artifacts inline, enable in settings.
